name: Rules Essentials
description: Provides missing functionality and documentation for the Rules module.
project_description: Rules Essentials (tr_rulez) augments the contrib Rules module for Drupal 10.3+/11. It adds Rules plugins that were missing from the Drupal 8+ port of Rules: new Conditions (flood-is-allowed, path-contains-text, path text comparison, site-in-maintenance-mode), new Actions (cache tag invalidator, flood register/clear event), new Events (user blocked/unblocked, entity bundle create/delete), a Condition set (XOR) expression, and two TypedData filters (link, raw). It also provides an optional improved Rules UI (enabled by default) that adds a clone operation for reaction rules and components, replacement list builders, and a reworked reaction-rule edit form. Two submodules ship with it: rules_examples (working example reaction-rule configurations distributed as config/optional, for learning and documentation) and rules_scheduler (a partially-implemented port of the D7 scheduler that stores tasks in a custom database table and drains them through a cron queue; several parts of the scheduler are stubbed/incomplete in 2.0.0). The module also supplies a Drush command to list field-type plugins, a D6/D7 rules-settings migration, and update hooks that renamed its events. Depends on the Rules module; requires the Typed Data API module (transitively via Rules).
